lines.text: Aarav's father collapses at work. Three weeks in hospital. Medical bills eat through savings. Aarav works double shifts.
I'm sorry. I know you wanted—
Before the hospital, Aarav weighed two things: intellectual challenge and family security. Challenge came first. Now family security dominates everything.
He looks at the same two options but weighs the attributes differently. Elster calls this prior change of attribute weights.
The question is whether the crisis revealed something genuine about his values — or whether deprivation forced one priority to drown out the others.
